messages:
maria: seeing weird noise in token-level TTFT vs decode attribution on route /chat/v2. started after kernel-selector change yesterday, some routes show TTFT spikes but decode time is low.
ajay: can you paste the route id + sample trace id? also maybe sampling bias from prefetch hitting only warm workers.
maria: route: chat-prod-eu, traces: 2b7f1c4f & 2b7f2d88. per-token breakdown observed in logs: TTFT=120ms, decode=30ms, kernel=25ms, queue=65ms — this is on Dedicated pool.
kim: fyi kernel-selector commit 9f3b2b7 went live ~03:12 UTC yesterday, it prefers microkernel for seq<=32. could be microkernel handoff overhead. snippet from deploy log:
```
INFO kernel-selector: choosing microkernel for seq<=32, fallback handoff cost ~18ms
```
evan: ran a quick perf probe on gpu-03. aggregated timings (nvprof-like):
```
KVCache.lookup avg=12ms (n=2000)
Scheduler.prequeue avg=60ms
Microkernel.exec avg=28ms
Nvlink transfer avg=4ms
```
shows scheduler+prequeue dominating.
sara: could batching heuristic be holding microbatches longer? what's batching window for that pool?
ajay: batching config on that pool: max_batch_delay=8ms, min_batch_size=4, batching-mode=adaptive. we do see microbatch spikes when traffic has lots of very small requests.
maria: perf-bot alerted earlier for chat-prod-eu: TTFT_rate(>200ms) exceeded threshold :rotating_light:
perf-bot: alert_id=PRF-1023, metric=ttft_p95, window=5m, value=212ms, threshold=200ms
kim: proposal: add per-route smoothing for kernel attribution to reduce attribution noise from handoff. e.g. export both raw_kernel_ms and smoothed_kernel_ms where smoothed = EWMA(raw, alpha=0.2). show both on dashboards.
evan: +1. also add trace tags batch_size and prefetch_hit so we can stratify and correct sampling bias. will instrument tracer to emit those labels.
sara: dashboard tasks: add panels 'kernel raw vs smoothed (p50/p95)', 'ttft breakdown by batch_size', and an annotation band for kernel-selector deploy times. I'll sketch a grafana layout.
ajay: quick promql snippet for metrics team to start with (but we need batch_size as label):
```
avg_over_time(ttft_token_ms{route="chat-prod-eu"}[5m])
```
prom can't easily join scalar labels — better to push batch_size as label at export time.
maria: action items: 1) kim to prototype EWMA smoothing in runtime metrics exporter (PR by EOD). 2) evan to add batch_size and prefetch_hit tags to traces and retest. 3) sara to add smoothed panels + deploy annotations. 4) ajay to run controlled load (tiny seqs) to reproduce.
kim: started branch export-smoothed-kernel-metrics. opt-in via env var REDWOOD_ENABLE_KERNEL_SMOOTHING=1. will include tests for alpha params.
maria: thanks all. if smoothing doesn't bring p95 under threshold we'll roll back selector change for small sequences. :thumbsup:
